The project manager lists $18,600.00 of materials stored on line 5, electrical and lighting: pendant and linear LED fixtures, reading room and stacks (42 units). propertyEvents.result: The billing system still withholds 10% on job S-2604; the owner approved 5% from application 7 on November 14, 2026. The contract lets the owner reduce retainage to 5% of the work completed and stored once the work is more than 50% complete. Application 6 brought it to 81%, and the owner's letter of November 14, 2026 approves 5% from application 7. At the system's 10%, retainage would be $37,000.00 and the current payment due $51,840.00. At 5% it is $18,500.00 and the payment due $70,340.00: $15,620.00 of the $31,240.00 held on earlier work is released and the new work carries 5%. Update the job's retainage rate in the billing system before the invoice is issued.
